summary: God appeared to Solomon in a dream and said, 'Ask for whatever you want.' Solomon didn't ask for riches or a long life. He asked for an understanding heart to lead God's people. God was pleased and gave him wisdom, plus riches and honor.

story_reel.narration: Young King Solomon loved Yahweh and followed his father's instructions. One night, Solomon went to a place called Gibeon to worship God. While he slept there, Yahweh appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Ask for whatever you want Me to give you.' Whatever you want! What would you ask for? Solomon could have asked for gold, a huge army, or a long life. But Solomon said, 'You showed great kindness to my father David. And now You've made me king in his place. But I'm like a little child. I don't know how to lead. And Your people are so many, too many to count. So please give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people, so I can tell the difference between good and evil.' God was very pleased with Solomon's request. He said, 'Because you asked for this, and not for a long life or riches or the defeat of your enemies, I will give you what you asked. I will give you a wise and understanding heart, like no one before you and no one after you. And I will also give you what you didn't ask for: riches and honor.' Then Solomon woke up. It had been a dream, but it was real. Solomon knew wisdom matters more than anything money can buy.

memory_verse.text: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil

identity_focus.core_truth: I can ask Yahweh for wisdom, and He loves to give it.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God told Solomon, 'Ask for whatever you want.' If God asked you that, what would you ask for, and why?

quiz.explanation: God said, 'Ask what I shall give you.'

quiz.question: What did Solomon ask for?
options: An understanding heart to lead God's people
quiz.explanation: Solomon asked, 'Give your servant an understanding heart to judge your people.'

quiz.question: What did God give Solomon besides wisdom?
quiz.explanation: God said, 'I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, I'm like a little child too. I don't always know what to do. Please give me an understanding heart so I can tell right from wrong. Amen.

companion.message: That dream changed my life. I knew I wasn't ready to be king on my own. Asking God for wisdom was the best decision I ever made.
